statement: Every continuous based loop in the actual closed-disk homeomorphism group fixing its original boundary pointwise and commuting on the interior with an actual closed locally compact free proper one-dimensional operator group has a based contraction in that same relative centralizer. Its fundamental group at the identity is zero. The remaining bounded nonabelian-base strips with independent endpoint characters are filled by a full-vector compact positive base average, two scalar comparison-plane fiber selections with the identical base, and a cutoff blend in that same original fiber. One common compact source family controls every map and inverse at all interior lines and the original circle.
depends_on: C75 actual principal strips and all component operators; C76 two-character source-vector and short-increment comparisons; C77 actual transitive scalar character/base actions; C78 Hilbert positive averages, compact local pair transports, two-stage selections and original-circle bounds; C62 actual equal-real-level triangle and inverse bracketing
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b), complete actual closed-disk relative loop filling for one-dimensional free proper interior operator groups.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The common base is selected from the full two-character fiber, while the two separate scalar selections use the same actual compact source family. Their fiber blend remains at that identical base level, retaining the C62 bound. Both alternatives in the finite-endpoint sequence proof are explicit, and every component operator including negative fiber multipliers is retained.
computational_checks: This is a qualitative loop-filling theorem. Its character constraints, cutoff identity, actual maps and inverses, common-family containments, and every finite-endpoint and original-circle limit are proved directly. No new numerical approximation or finite classification is used.
notes: The theorem concerns the actual original closed disk and its exact relative centralizer. It requires no Fuchsian compactification comparison. It proves the based loop assertion and vanishing fundamental group, without asserting global contractibility or higher homotopy groups. It does not supply a lift through the prime-end injection for a different non-locally-connected original domain, nor complete the remaining arbitrary-surface C12 problem. All prior accepted or frozen fragments remain unchanged.
